name: LinkedIn Company API | Firmographics & Sales Intelligence
description: Collect public LinkedIn company pages as clean, structured JSON. Send company URLs or search by company name and get industry, size, headquarters, followers, specialties, and locations, ready to chain into Crunchbase funding lookup by name. Pay per company, MCP-ready for Claude and AI agents.
